title: E0102: Command Injection via proc_open
plain_english: Passing user input to `proc_open()` as part of a command can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on your server.
why_matters: Command injection via `proc_open()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Achieve full server compromise
what_it_checks: `proc_open()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
